attorneys: Messrs. Mark D. Eagleton and Merritt U. Hayden for petitioner. Messrs. Thomas M. Pierce and J. L. Howell for respondent.

opinions.text: It appearing that the judgment of the Supreme Court of Missouri is a final judgment under the decisions of that Court cited by petitioner in his petition for rehearing, the petition is granted, the order denying a writ of certiorari [post, p. 688] is vacated and the writ of certiorari is granted.
